lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 논문 정리는 잘 되고 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, how's your paper coming along?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, nonmun jeongnineun jal doego isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 교수님. 연구실에서 매일 쓰고 있습니다.
lines.en: Yes, professor. I'm writing in the lab every day.
lines.roman: Ne, gyosunim. Yeongusireseo maeil sseugo itseumnida.

lines.learner: 네, 경제학 자료를 단기간에 많이 모았습니다.
lines.en: Yes, I gathered a lot of economics data in a short time.
lines.roman: Ne, gyeongjehak jaryoreul dangigane mani moatseumnida.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 그럼 연구 성과를 한마디로 말해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Good. Then can you sum up your results in a word?
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo. Geureom yeongu seonggwareul hanmadiro malhae bollaeyo?
lines.en: To put it in a word, we overturned the existing theory.
It's an economic theory about labor efficiency.

lines.beaver: 다른 연구자들도 그 결과를 알고 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Do other researchers know about the results?
lines.beaver_roman: Dareun yeongujadeuldo geu gyeolgwareul algo isseoyo?
lines.en: They don't know yet. I want to present it first.
I plan to present at a conference next month.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 학위 논문에도 그 내용을 넣을 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: Good. Will you put it in your thesis too?
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo. Hagwi nonmunedo geu naeyongeul neoeul kkeoyeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 학위 논문의 중심으로 삼고 싶습니다.
lines.en: Yes, I want to make it the core of my thesis.
lines.roman: Ne, hagwi nonmunui jungsimeuro samkko sipseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: As a researcher, what do you think of scholarship?
lines.en: An intellectual is someone who knows their own ignorance.

lines.beaver: 좋은 생각이에요. 연구자에게 가장 중요한 건요?
lines.beaver_en: Nice thought. What matters most for a researcher?
lines.beaver_roman: Joeun saenggagieyo. Yeongujaege gajang jungyohan geonyo?
lines.learner: 백과사전에 없는 새 지식을 만드는 겁니다.
lines.en: Creating new knowledge that isn't in encyclopedias.
lines.roman: Baekkwasajeone eomneun sae jisigeul mandeuneun geomnida.

lines.beaver: 훌륭해요. 그럼 다음 주에 초고를 가져와요.
lines.beaver_en: Excellent. Then bring me a draft next week.
lines.beaver_roman: Hullyunghaeyo. Geureom daeum jue chogoreul gajyeowayo.
lines.en: Yes, professor. Thank you. I'll prepare hard.
